text:
sam_procure: NexaSupply just offered to combine the 12-unit RMA shipment with our incoming 48-unit allocation to avoid paying duties twice. they can issue a duty credit on the consolidated commercial invoice but need confirmation by EOD. thoughts?

maria_infra: combining OK from infra side if replacements hit same datacenter. will it change ETA? :thinking:

alex_logistics: need HS codes + who covers brokerage. air vs consolidated air+truck could change cost. can we get an estimate of duty credit amount?
jordan_vendor: we can net a duty credit up to 8% of shipment CIF value if shipped on one AWB and single commercial invoice. will need PO #, RMA list, and preferred AWB consolidation instructions by EOD PST. no extra lead time for us — we batch at origin.
sam_procure: good. PO is PO-88921. jordan_vendor can you confirm which AWB you'd use and if we can supply our customs broker info?
jordan_vendor: AWB proposal: 123-456789012. we can either bill freight to Nexa or to Redwood. broker details okay — please send secure link or KMS-encrypted sheet. for credit we need the RMA serials matched to replacements.
maria_infra: I'll push serial list to procurement shortly. combining is fine as long as replacements are labeled for DC-A racks 3/4. no swap delays.
dock_ops: pack instructions — please palletize separate: NewUnits_Pallet1, RMA_Pallet2 but on same AWB. we need manifest entry: "RETURN_NOTE: RMA_COMBINE" and single commercial invoice with line items flagged as RMA vs New. otherwise customs rejects.
procure-bot: Shipment hold/booking pending: AWB 123-456789012 (pending vendor confirmation). ETA window estimate: 2024-10-02 — 2024-10-05.

sam_procure: @jordan_vendor can you add the projected duty credit number to the commercial invoice (line comment) so finance can model cashflow? also confirm if credit will be a refund or a direct invoice credit.
jordan_vendor: we'll annotate invoice with estimated duty credit (~USD 7,200) and issue a credit memo applied against the freight/invoice within 30 days after clearance. need RMA list now.
maria_infra: posting RMA list now: 
```
RMA_LIST:
RMA-9001 H100 SN: H100-00011234
RMA-9002 H100 SN: H100-00011278
RMA-9003 H200 SN: H200-00022100
```

alex_logistics: please include HS codes: 8471.80.0000 for main board assemblies and 8542.31.0000 for modules. tell broker to use consolidated invoice and to mark RMA items as "returned for repair" to avoid VAT charge in customs if possible.
jordan_vendor: confirmed HS codes added. vendor will mark RMA lines as "returned for repair". we will also provide a consolidated packing list and weight dims by COB.
dock_ops: on our side, pls set label template to include: PO-88921 / AWB 123-456789012 / RMA_COMBINE. we need a pallet manifest in CSV with columns: pallet_id, items, weight_kg, dims_cm, dc_destination.
sam_procure: thanks everyone. if vendor confirms credit memo flow and AWB by EOD, we proceed. otherwise we fallback to separate RMA air shipments (higher duty). :thumbsup:
jordan_vendor: AWB confirmed and manifest will be sent in 2 hours. credit memo flow as described. final ask — can you confirm Redwood broker contact and KYC email?
sam_procure: sending secure broker contact now via SSM link. final note: finance wants consolidated invoice copy before customs clearance to prebook duty credit.
jordan_vendor: understood — will attach invoice + annotated credit estimate when we send manifest.
maria_infra: approved from infra. arrange DC receiving slot for 10/03 morning.
procure-bot: Booking update: AWB 123-456789012 confirmed, carrier: AirBridge Express, manifest uploaded at 2333333338.
sam_procure: perfect — moving forward. thanks all.
